title: Recovery and support continue after the Kumamoto earthquake
summary: Government, U.S. Armed Forces, the imperial family and companies send aid; Kumamoto Castle reopens and misinformation is being countered.

title: Tenri defeats Fukuoka and advances in the Koshien summer baseball tournament
summary: The Nara team prevailed with an early home run by Kanemoto and solid pitching to achieve its 80th victory in spring and summer.

title: Yokohama defeats Okinawa Shogaku in the Koshien champions showdown
summary: Starter Oda dominated with 12 strikeouts and Yokohama's offense prevailed over the spring champion.

title: Two siblings die swept away by waves at a Niigata beach
summary: An elementary school boy and his junior high school sister died after being swept away by waves in an accident at a seaside resort.

title: Takagawa Gakuen overcomes Takaoka Shogyo in the first round of Koshien
summary: Starter Kinoshita completed the victory with one earned run, while Takaoka sank due to six errors.

title: U.S. reaffirms its military commitment in Asia with exercises and visits
summary: The Pentagon underscores its presence in the region while Seoul and Washington conduct joint maneuvers.

title: Nagasaki peace ceremony marked by Taiwan's absence
summary: The mayor seeks Taiwan's understanding while the peace declaration recalls human suffering.

title: Chunichi Dragons coach suffers traffic accident in Tokyo
summary: His car collided with a cyclist in Koganei; the other person involved was slightly injured.

title: Business bankruptcies increase in Japan
summary: July bankruptcies reached an annual high and those of mobile game developers are setting a record pace.

title: Mao Shimada leads the Summer Cup figure skating; Yuna Aoki is second
summary: The champion leads the short program and the competition will be decided in the free skate.

title: Typhoon 15 approaches Tohoku and Kanto with an unusual trajectory
summary: Authorities warn of possible landslides and a possible landfall in Fukushima or Ibaraki.

title: Bank of Japan debates accelerating rate hikes and the real estate market reacts
summary: At the July meeting several members called for a faster pace of adjustment, while the U.S. government studies a coordinated intervention.

title: An hour of interrogation of a former special prosecutor released in court
summary: The tape includes comments about antisocial groups and drew mixed reactions among attendees.

title: Japanese stocks rise sharply and Nikkei surpasses 66,000 points
summary: The Japanese market extends its rally driven by buying of technology and semiconductor stocks.

title: Japan considers remotely analyzing phones of anonymous criminal groups
summary: Police seek a new tool to access device information and dismantle 'tokuryu' organizations.

title: Iran hardens its stance in the Strait of Hormuz while Japan seeks to secure transit
summary: The country appoints a hawk for defense and demands conditions from the U.S., amid the arrival of a Canadian tanker in Japan.

title: Japan debates minimum wage hikes: Fukuoka raises by 57 yen and Aomori remains without agreement
summary: Fukuoka's committee recommended an increase to 1,114 yen, while in Aomori the parties failed to reach consensus.

title: Rakuten achieves first operating profit in seven years and agrees to reduce roaming with KDDI
summary: The company posted 50.4 billion yen in operating profit in the first half and will cut its use of KDDI's network.

title: Economy Ministry official suspended for handing over bank passbook
summary: The public employee was sanctioned with a three-month suspension for transferring an account to a third party.
